name: Abalone Gift Box Display
summary: Twelve clear-lid two-can gift boxes on a three-tier countertop riser.
description: Original S10 P2 display with lacquer-look red, champagne-gold and black rectangular gift boxes, 24 plain cans, ribbon bands, twelve blank gift cards and a blank sign. Static visual prop.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and shared procedural materials with vertex colors; no external assets, textures, fonts, labels or brands.

display.origin: floor centre; place this datum on the shop counter

accuracy_notes: Dimensions and topology are measured from the exported GLB in metrics. Nominal illustrative can and gift dimensions do not reproduce real packaging. Thin alpha-blended glazing approximates a clear lid without refraction. Static prop; no opening animation, collision, purchase logic or assembled-mall performance certification. Physical Android/iOS, WebKit and full-mall performance unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials created for this repository. No external assets; existing GJH can models were inspected and left unchanged.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.acceptance_scope: Independent source, editability and GLB checks; full repository and browser results are in reports/checks.json and reports/browser.json.
